title: MSFS 2024 Marketplace Update (March 28, 2026) – Explore Polynesia with This NEW 8‑Leg Grand Tour!
description:
The Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 Marketplace Update for March 28, 2026 is here with the new 8LEGS Grand Tour Polynesia! This MSFS 2024 Marketplace Update features the latest MSFS 2024 activities and missions for PC, specifically the 8LEGS Grand Tour Polynesia by Perfect Flight.

On March 28, 2026, this week’s Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 Marketplace Update brings a must-have new release for PC pilots. The stunning 8LEGS GRAND TOUR – POLYNESIA is now available to take your MSFS 2024 island hopping experience to the next level.

🗺️ New activities added this week (PC)
The following activity (missions & miscellaneous) was newly released in the marketplace this week:

🗺️ Perfect Flight: 8LEGS GRAND TOUR – POLYNESIA (Multi‑leg island hopping tour across French Polynesia)

If you enjoy discovering new content every week, don’t forget to like the video, subscribe to the channel, and drop a comment below to let us know if you’ll be flying this new Polynesian tour!

Thanks for watching and happy flying ✈️ See you in the skies!
